raw_comment: After observing the graph, I have noticed that there is a severe drought in Nebraska and Wyoming. This makes me wonder if the animals over there can survive. The drought reminds me of one I had studied before. It was 21st century drought, which had occurred in several regions of the United States, including the American Southwest, the Lower 48 states, Alaska, and the southern United States. After the drought, some recent effects were the causing widespread ecosystem changes, including increased wildfire risk, altered plant communities, etc.  A catchy headline would be "The drought brought by the U.S."
